He played that very, very late! Coming in with the arm, sliding on. Powell waits ages for it and keeps it out past short leg at the last moment.
Tossed up delivery, dealt with nicely by coming forward.

Well played! Not that short but Hope hangs back and cuts it expertly with the spin through cover-point. Raza from the cover region sprints after it. He is lightning quick across the turf and slides near the rope to keep the ball in play. Two runs taken.
He is looking confident at the crease. Leans ahead nicely and drives it to the same fielder.
Backs away to the full delivery and strokes it to short cover.
Slow through the air, Shai presses forward and buries it into the track.
Hope reads the googly this time and works it nicely to square leg.
Tossed up outside off, played with an angled bat to point.
Coming in with the arm, tucked to the mid-wicket fielder.
FOUR! A welcome boundary for Windies! Short and spinning away, Powell rocks back and slaps it through covers to find the fence.
Sloppy work! Full toss on middle, Powell knocks it towards Mire at mid on and sets off to the danger end. Mire attacks the ball but makes a meal of the effort. Concedes two runs.
Tossed up delivery, defended solidly off the front foot.
Short delivery, Powell hangs back and cuts it to backward point.
Floated delivery, eased to mid off.
That almost sneaked through! Cremer slips in the googly, Hope reads it very late, perhaps off the pitch and somehow manages to play it to backward square leg.
Strides forward to this one and defends it confidently.
Short delivery, spinning away. Hope cuts it nicely through cover-point. The fielder from point hares after it and keeps it down to a couple.
Full in line of the stumps, Hope makes room and taps it to mid off.
Backs away to this one and strokes it to mid on.
Shorter delivery at a quicker pace, punched off the back foot. A productive over for Raza.
Tossed up delivery, eased to deepish mid off for a run.
Played through mid-wicket by the batsman.
Around leg stump, turning away sharply. Shai goes back and tucks it to backward square leg.
Fullish delivery, Shai drives it confidently to mid on.
Time for Drinks. Meanwhile, Shai Hope strides out to bat. He is a solid middle order batsman and will look to brave out the tough conditions.

OUT! It was not a wise decision to take the review and the visitors have exhausted one. Since Raza has come into the attack, he has been on the money and is reaping the dividends. Bowls this one slow through the air well outside off, gets substantial inward spin after the ball pitches. Hope hangs deep in the crease and tries to block it but misses to get hit low on the pads. Zimbabwe appeal vociferously and up goes the umpire's finger. Kyle walks across to Powell and consults with him about the review. He goes for it eventually. Time for the replays. They show three reds and the batsman is a dead duck. Good passage of play for the hosts.
Zimbabwe are breathing fire at the moment! Kyle Hope has been adjudged LBW and he looks like a goner but he opts for the review.

A vociferous appeal for a catch turned down! Floated outside off, Powell strides forward to defend but it looks like he has missed it. The ball deflects off the pads and carries to Masakadza at first slip. Only the keeper, Chakabva is confident. Cremer walks across to him and asks him whether he should challenge the decision. They decide not to do it. Rightly so, as the Snicko doesn't spot a nick.
Outside off, Powell plants his front foot across and pads it away.
That's a brute of a delivery! Wrong one at a quicker pace on off, Powell looks to counter it by staying back but is beaten by the sharp away turn.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Tossed up delivery, eased off the front foot to mid on.
On a flatter trajectory, Powell sits back and answers it with a straight bat.
On middle and leg, helped with the spin to the leg side.
Waits deep in the crease and steers it to third man for a run.
Spinning away from Powell, he rocks back and places it to point.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.

Did that carry? Raza is in the midst of a good spell. Quicker around off, Powell pushes at it with hard hands and gets an outside edge. Masakadza dives to his left but the ball just goes wide of him and towards third man. A couple taken.
Flatter delivery, Powell stays back and blocks it.

That was a jaffa! Quicker through the air on middle, Hope has no option but to play at it and is convincingly beaten by the sharp away turn and bounce. He is lucky to survive that. Cremer's followthrough suggests that he enjoyed that.
Slow through the air, Kyle presses forward and defends it to the off side.
Fraction short this time, cut away to the point region.
Straighter on this occasion, Hope stonewalls it.
Leans confidently ahead and strokes it to the cover region.
Tossed up delivery, Kyle prods forward and blocks it stoutly.
Covers the line to this one and answers it with a straight bat.
On a flatter trajectory, Hope works it through square leg for a run. Easy singles are on offer. The mid on should be perhaps brought up.
The batsman has flicked the ball off his pads.
Slow through the air, Hope strides forward and buries it into the track.
Floated delivery, Hope puts his head down and defends it calmly.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
The sun is shining brightly and that has led to the wicket drying up even more. As a result, the ball is spinning and gripping and the batsmen are finding it difficult.
Clips this one with the spin past short leg.
On leg stump, Powell tries to clip it across but is hit on the pads.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Slower through the air, Powell comes forward and blocks it.
Drifting towards the pads, turned to the leg side.
Quicker in pace, defended solidly off the back foot.

Not Out! The impact saves Kyle Hope! The home side wastes a review. Floated outside off, spinning in. Hope prods forward to defend but is hit on the back leg. The hosts roar in an appeal but the umpire shakes his head. Raza is confident and tells his skipper to take the review. Time for the replays. The Snicko shows a deviation but it is of the bat hitting the ground. The Hawk Eye rolls in. It shows the impact is outside off and that's the end of the story. End of an eventful over.
Right then, review time! Has Raza taken two wickets in the same over? He convinces his skipper to go for the review. However, it seems that the impact is outside the line.
Full toss outside off, Hope goes for an expansive drive but mistimes it down the wicket.
Kyle Hope comes out to bat.

OUT! The resistance from the nightwatchman has come to a close but he has done a decent job for his side. Slow through the air on middle, Bishoo cleans his front leg and goes at it with hard hands. Ends up playing it straight back to Raza who cups it safely. Bishoo was dropped on 20 but it hasn't cost much. The 55-run stand also comes to an end. More importantly, it consumed 101 balls which would have irritated the hosts to no end.
Slow through the air, Bishoo comes forward and blocks it right under his eyes.
A bit shorter this time, Devendra hangs back and blocks it.
Floated around off, Powell hangs back and guides it to third man for a run.
Full and straight, clipped to deepish mid on for a single.
The wrong one from Cremer. Bishoo spots it well and answers it with a straight bat.
Quicker through the air, Bishoo makes use of the depth of the crease to stonewall it.
Full outside off, Powell eases it through covers to rotate strike.
Floated delivery, Powell lunges forward in defense.
Shortish delivery, Bishoo hangs back and cuts it nicely to sweeper cover. A run taken. Low risk cricket this from the nightwatchman.
Slow through the air, Kieran strides forward and strokes it towards mid off.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Around off, spins away. Powell makes a tight leave.
Leans into this one and strokes it straight to Raza.
Full on off, Powell presses forward in defense.
Floated delivery, defended solidly off the front foot.
Powell taps this one to the off side for a run and will retain strike.
Driven towards the mid on region. They pick up a single.
Tossed up delivery, eased through mid off for a single. That brings up the 50-run stand between the two. Vital stand this, good going from the duo.
Floated delivery, defended solidly off the front foot.

Dropped! You won't get an easier catch than that. Slow through the air and on a fullish length on off, Bishoo goes for the big sweep but top edges it. Brendan Taylor at mid-wicket goes back a bit, seems to have it covered but drops a sitter. He is complaining about the sun but he had his sunglasses on.
Tossed up delivery, driven to deepish mid off for a single.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Driven through mid on by the batsman. They pick up a single.
Played through mid-wicket by Bishoo. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Played to mid-wicket region by the batsman. One run added to the total.
The batsman flicks it away with a wristy shot.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Bishoo shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Hangs deep in the crease and has ample time to clip this through square leg to rotate strike.
Similar delivery, Devendra pushes hard at it but gets it off the outer half to short third man. A run taken.
Full on middle, Bishoo leans forward and strokes it to mid off.
Quick and flat, Bishoo lunges forward in defense.

There is a conversation going on between the Zimbabwe players. Something out of the box might do the trick to break this stand. Taylor bowls handy off spin while Masakadza also has a knack of breaking partnerships.
Stays back and works it through backward square leg for a single.
Slow through the air, defended solidly off the front foot.
FOUR! Well played! Bishoo is shining in his batting as well. Tossed up outside off, Bishoo extends his arms and lifts it over mid off for a boundary. This will be frustrating for Zimbabwe.
98 kph in pace on middle and leg, Powell looks to keep it out but gets a thick inside edge towards fine leg. A run taken.

Quicker in pace, around leg stump. Powell tries to whip it across but is struck on the pads. A chirpy appeal for an LBW is denied. That seemed to be pitching outside leg and might have also been going down.
Around leg stump, Powell looks to work it past short leg and it goes straight to Craig Ervine. He fumbles it but was that a catch? Not quite sure. Seemed like pad.
Some nice flight on this one, Bishoo blocks it right under his nose.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Sits deep in the crease and works this flatter delivery to the leg side for a single.
Bishoo looks to drive this one but gets it off the inner half to mid-wicket. A run taken.
Spinning into Bishoo. He stays back and turns it to mid-wicket.
The batsman flicks it away with a wristy shot. One run added to the total.
Quicker in pace, worked to mid-wicket for a single.
That was streaky! Arm ball from Chisoro. Powell is not sure whether to come forward or go back. Is stranded and gets an outside edge past first slip. Two runs taken.
On middle and leg, Bishoo turns it through square leg to get off strike.
Spinning down the leg side, Bishoo tries to play it across but misses. The keeper doesn't stop it cleanly.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Tossed up delivery, Bishoo smothers the spin nicely.
Shortish delivery, extra bounce there. Bishoo is surprised by it and gets an outside edge past first slip. A run taken.
Slow through the air, Bishoo defends it solidly.
Bishoo is on the move as he taps it with soft hands to mid on.
Around off, driven crisply to mid off for a run.
Fullish delivery, Powell drives it to the left side of Cremer who moves across and stops it nicely.
Floated delivery, Powell strides forward and blocks it.
Bishoo drills  this one straight to Chisoro who makes a good save and mimes a throw back.

That was close! That was nicely bowled. A bit quicker through the air, not much spin. Bishoo prods forward to defend but gets an outside edge. Masakadza at first slip dives to his right but the ball falls just short of him and goes past him to third man. Two runs taken.
The short leg was in the firing zone there! Short deivery, Bishoo hammers it hard and it just evades the fielder. Races towards deep square leg for a couple. 100 UP FOR WEST INDIES.
Coming in with the arm, tucked through square leg for a run.

FOUR! In the arc and hit away with ease! Full on middle, Powell clears his front leg and hoicks it over mid-wicket. The fielder at wide long on races to his left but has no chance to stop it. There comes the intent from the West Indies. Could not see much of it yesterday.
Flighted delivery, Powell puts his head down and defends it calmly.

This is not good captaincy from Cremer. He has pushed back the fielders to long on and deep mid-wicket for Bishoo as well. Early in the day, you need to put pressure on the batsmen. More so when you are still leading by a substantial margin.
Camps back and places it against the spin to point for a single.
Short on middle, Powell rocks back and pulls it to deep mid-wicket. The fielder in the deep runs to his left and cuts it off. Two runs taken.
Floated outside off, driven against the spin to the cover region.
Defended off the back foot by the batsman.
Quicker through the air, Kieran stays back and stonewalls it.
Full on middle, knocked down to long on for a run.
Flatter and quick delivery, kept out watchfully.
Drifting towards the pads, Devendra works it to the leg side for a run.
Floated delivery, Bishoo lunges forward in defense.

4th Test fifty for Kieran Powell! He was dropped twice in the same over by Cremer of his own bowling and is making merry at the moment. Spinning into Powell, he tucks it nicely to deep mid-wicket for a single. Masakadza was also given a life and he scored a big one. Kieran will look to follow in his footsteps. He scored a half century in the previous game as well but could not carry on. He will aim for a big one here.
Short and spinning away, cut hard but straight to the man at backward point.
Floated around off, Powell drives it back to the bowler.
Intent from Bishoo! Tossed up outside off, Bishoo creams it through covers for a brace.  7 from the over, good start from West Indies.
Spinning into Powell who hangs deep in the crease and works it past short leg to rotate strike.
Slower through the air, Kieran presses forward in defense.
Flatter delivery, Powell hangs back and defends it solidly.
Floated delivery, defended solidly off the front foot.
FOUR! Poor delivery and duly punished! Short and outside off, Powell rocks back and cuts it through cover for a boundary. The first of Day 3.
Graeme Cremer to bowl from the other end.
Down the leg side, Bishoo gets a bit of bat on it and the ball goes past the diving leg slip fielder towards fine leg. Two runs taken.
Stays back to this one and keeps it out.

What happened there? Full delivery around off, Bishoo looks to jam it out but misses it. It seems that the ball clipped the pads of the keeper and deflected onto the stumps. The home side looks towards the square leg umpire but he stays put. The replays confirm that it deflected from the keeper. There was no chance of a stumping either as Bishoo's back foot was well in the crease.
Floated delivery, defended solidly off the front foot.
Similar delivery, Powell wrists it nicely to deep mid-wicket for a run.
Leg slip in place for Bishoo and long on also comes in.
Full on middle and leg, clipped with the spin to short mid-wicket.

We are set to get rolling. The Zimbabwe side is in a huddle and Cremer has some words of wisdom for his teammates. Much warmer conditions today which is a good sign for the players as well as the crowd. Kieran Powell to continue his innings and the nightwatchman, Devendra Bishoo joins him at the crease. Tendai Chisoro to start off with the ball. A slip and short leg in place.

PITCH REPORT - Tino Mawoyo doing the pitch report says that the track has started to deteriorate. Mentions that the man who stood out here was Masakadza. Feels that the surface has dried up and Chisoro has extracted good purchase from the City End. Reckons that the Windies batted a bit slow yesterday but they have got a good platform.

The away side played rather slowly yesterday. Their run rate is 1.59 per over at the moment which they will strive to better by taking the initiative. The scoreboard needs to be kept ticking otherwise the home side can put a lot of pressure on West Indies. The wicket will only get harder as time progresses and that should be kept in mind. The third day is often considered to be the moving one of a Test match and expect a lot of action today. The good news is that the sun is shining in all its glory and we can expect to get in the allotted 98 overs.

Hello and a warm welcome for Day 3 of the second and final Test between Zimbabwe and West Indies in Bulawayo. The match is nicely poised at the moment with the visitors holding a bit of the upper hand courtesy a grinding opening stand. However, it will be a stern test for the batsmen as the surface has already started to grip and turn. If the tourists provide a sniff to the home side, that might just lead them to slope downhill.
... Day 3, Session 1 ...

The spinners did the bulk of the bowling for the home side and ran through the overs. Mpofu also bowled his heart out but didn't get any reward. Earlier in the day, the hosts batted really well to get past the 300-run mark courtesy Masakadza and Raza. The former scored a brilliant ton while the latter missed it by a small margin. However, the visitors have responded well. The hosts need to pick up wickets at consistent intervals to pull back the initiative. Join us for an eventful third day's play tomorrow which will start half an hour earlier at 0930 local time (0730 GMT). Till then, adios and take care!

An absorbing day of Test cricket comes to a close. The Windies openers did a really good job of grinding it out in the middle. They were going strong but the Zimbabwe skipper came back for a bowl and removed Brathwaite with a beauty just prior to the end of Day 2. Powell has been rather lucky. He was dropped twice by Cremer and is making reasonable use of the lives.

SAFE! Devendra Bishoo survives! But this is another superb delivery from the skipper. He drifts it across the nightwatchman, Bishoo once again falls in the trap as he looks to drive. Misses and Chakabva behind the stumps takes the bails off. They refer it upstairs and replays show that Bishoo had his foot grounded. STUMPS DECLARED ON DAY 2!
Drama on the last ball of the day! A stumping appeal against Bishoo is taken upstairs but the batsman seems to be confident. Let's wait and find out...
Excellent googly and it's acknowledged by Bishoo! A bit short, turning the other way, Bishoo goes chasing after it and is almost done in by it.
A bit full around middle, pushed back to the bowler.
Leans a bit across to this ball outside off and defends.
Tossed up ball around middle and leg, Bishoo blocks it down.
Drifts it away outside off, Powell drives it down to long off to bring Bishoo back on strike.
Possibly the last over of the day...
Gets a stride forward and drives it straight to silly point who wears it on his chest.
Fuller and looped outside off, buried into the ground.
Stays behind the line and blocks it out watchfully.
A bit short and outside off, seeing the width Bishoo goes back and slaps it. Finds the man at cover-point.
Slower through the air around off, Bishoo blocks it solidly off the front foot.
Flatter and bowled outside off, crunched off the back foot through covers for a single.
We are done with the overs scheduled for the day. But we still have over 5 minutes remaining, which means we can get in a couple of overs more. There is a change, Sikandar Raza is back on.
Flatter delivery, defended solidly off the back foot. End of a productive over.
The nightwatchman, Devendra Bishoo is the new man in. Can he do the job for what he has been sent for?

OUT! The skipper brings himself back into the attack and strikes straightaway before the end of day's play. Brilliant bowling from him and he gets the reward. Drops this one shorter on off, quicker in pace too and it spins away appreciably. Brathwaite hangs back to keep it out but gets an outside edge. The ball flies towards Masakadza at first slip who bends to take a good catch. The umpires tell Kraigg to wait as they check for the front foot no ball. The replays roll in. It is tight but the bowler gets the benefit of the doubt. The 76-run marathon opening stand comes to an end as it came off 281 balls.
Now, then... The umpires check for the front foot no ball. It looks very close.
Full delivery, kept out watchfully.
Tossed up on off, defended solidly off the front foot.
Fullish in line of the stumps, a bit of drift in the air. Brathwaite comes forward and smothers the spin nicely.
Tossed up delivery on middle, Brathwaite lunges forward in defense.
Graeme Cremer has brought himself back into the attack.
Quicker delivery on leg stump, Powell looks to keep it out but is hit on the pads.
Clipped with the spin to mid-wicket for a run.

Not Out! Clearly a bump ball. Fullish delivery on middle and leg, Brathwaite jams it out and it goes towards the short leg fielder who catches it and appeals. The rest of the Zimbabwe players join in. The umpires get together and decide to refer it upstairs. However, the soft signal is not out! Time for the replays. At the first look only, it is confirmed that it is a bump ball.
What happened there? The home side is claiming a catch at short leg. However, the on-field umpires' soft signal is not out. Let's wait and find out whether it carried on the full...
Short delivery which allows enough time to Brathwaite to rock back and cut it to backward point.
Good running! Powell taps the fullish delivery to covers and calls his partner through for a swift single.

FOUR! A boundary after ages. Finally runs scored off Chisoro's bowling after 4 consecutive maidens. Spinning down the leg side, Powell whips it past the short leg fielder. There is no protection in the deep and the ball races to the fence.
Fullish delivery, tailing into Brathwaite. The bat again turns in his hands as he clips it off the inner half to short mid-wicket. Testing over from Mpofu.
Wider outside off this time, Kraigg doesn't poke at it.
Fuller in length on off, some extra bounce on that. Brathwaite adjusts well and blocks it solidly.
Full delivery on middle and leg, defended to the leg side.

Well bowled! A bit of nibble in the air and it is enough to trouble the batsman. Full length ball, swinging in sharply. Brathwaite tries to clip it away with the angle but the bat turns in his hands. He ends up getting it off the inner half and on the bounce to the man at square leg. Three fielders have been strategically placed, two short mid-wickets are there in place as well to wait for the false shot.
Back of a length on middle, Powell shuffles across and turns it through mid-wicket for an easy single.
Coming in with the arm, defended besides the pitch on the leg side. Fourth consecutive maiden for Chisoro.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
A bit shorter this time which allows Brathwaite time to hang back and block it.
Steep turn and bounce! Tossed up on middle, shoots off the surface. Brathwaite comes forward to block it but the ball hits the high part of the willow and lobs towards the point region.
Drifting towards the pads, clipped with the angle to short fine leg.
Quicker through the air around off, turning away. Kraigg waits for it and lets it go.
Another bouncer but down the leg side, Powell makes an easy leave.
As expected, with a man in the deep on the leg side, Mpofu brings out the short delivery. It is well-directed as well and Powell ducks under the bumper.
A man at deep square leg now.

Slightly overpitched outside off, Brathwaite creams it through covers. Three fielders rush after it and it is Raza who is the quickest. He slides near the ropes to keep the ball in play. Saves a run for his side.
Angling into Brathwaite who turns it to mid-wicket.
In the channel outside off, left alone.

Was that a chance? The replays confirm it was a chance. Half-volley outside off, Powell leans into it and drills it past the diving Taylor at short extra cover. He got a hand to it and hence, the ball slows down on the outfield. Mire gives it a chase and saves a run for his side. Very tough to take those, it was hit very hard.
Quick and flat on middle, jammed out to the short mid-wicket fielder. Another maiden for Chisoro.
Sharp turn and bounce again as Brathwaite makes a good leave.
Fuller in length, tapped to mid on.
Spinning away from Brathwaite and he lets it go this time.

This is really good bowling from Chisoro. Tossed up on off, Kraigg comes forward to block it but is beaten black and blue by the sharp turn. It stays low as well but Chakabva does really well to gather it.
Slow through the air on middle, Brathwaite prods forward and smothers the turn smartly.
Good length delivery angling into Powell who answers it with a straight bat.
Pacy delivery well outside off, Kieran plants his front foot across and doesn't fiddle with it.
Slower one on a full length on off, Powell spots it and drills it to the fielder at mid on.
Length delivery on off, defended neatly to mid off.
Kieran shuffles a bit to the fullish delivery and blocks it solidly to mid off.
In the corridor of uncertainty, angling in but not that much. Powell lets it go.
Tossed up delivery, Brathwaite lunges forward in defense. A testing over from Chisoro.
Ripper! Quicker through the air on off, Brathwaite has no option but to play at it and gets foxed all ends up by the sharp turn and bounce.
Very full on off, jammed out to mid on.
Rocks back to the flatter delivery and punches it to cover-point.
Shortish this time, cut with the spin to backward point.

That's a peach! Slow through the air on middle and gets it to spin away sharply. Brathwaite prods forward to defend but gets beaten all ends up. The keeper collects it and whips off the bails in a flash but the batsman is in. Just when he slowed down his speed, he has got one to whizz past the outside edge of the batsman.
Good bowling! On a driving length outside off, it seams away after pitching. Kieran doesn't fiddle with it. A maiden for Mpofu.
Fuller in length outside off, coming in substantially. Powell covers his off stump and makes a good leave.
Good length delivery in the zone of apprehension, Powell points his bat skywards to allow it through.
Length delivery this time, shaping in sharply. Powell makes use of the depth of the crease to tuck it to short mid-wicket.
Very full delivery, coming in with the angle. Kieran jams it out down the track.
Full length delivery around off, Powell strides forward and strokes it to mid off.
Short delivery, Brathwaite hangs back and cuts it with the spin to the point region.
Stays back to the flatter delivery and answers it with a straight bat.
Chisoro is bowling quick through the air and he needs to slow it up. The track is conducive for spin and he needs to realize that quickly to be more effective.
On middle and leg, worked to the man at 45.
Around the pads, turned around the corner for a single.
Full delivery on off, Powell winds up for a big shot but the length is not there to execute it. Ends up jamming it back to the bowler.
Pushed quicker through the air on middle, pushed defensively to the man at short leg.
Attacking the stumps with another in dipper, Kraigg is up to it as he eases it to mid on.
Substantial movement! Fullish again, swinging in a long way. Brathwaite covers the line and tucks it to short mid-wicket.
Fullish and tailing in from around off, Kaigg closes his bat face and eases it to the man in front of square leg.
Full length delivery in line of the stumps, played with soft hands to mid on.
Similar delivery, this time Powell gets some bat on it and gets it towards square leg. For some strange reason, the umpire signals it as a leg bye.
Runs in from around the wicket and bowls a length ball on leg stump, Powell looks to work it away but is hit around the hips.

Drinks are on the field! Phew! We needed a break! The Zimbabwe spinners are bowling in tandem, no respite at all. Just 11 overs are left in the day with an hour to go. But Kudos to the Windies' openers as they have dealt with anything and everything thrown at them. They have kept the hosts at bay and it would be interesting to see if they can go into day 3 unscathed. Powell especially, was dropped twice and he would be looking to make it count. Meanwhile, Chris Mpofu returns for a bowl. A lot of time is left and hence, the pacer has been brought back for a bowl.
Bowls it short and outside off, Brathwaite says I have got nothing to offer to this one as he leaves it alone.
A bit short and flatter in nature, dabbed off the back foot towards backward point.
Loopy ball outside off, driven towards the fielder at mid off.
Around middle and off, pushed towards the cover region.
More flight from Tendai, whipped through mid-wicket for a single.

FOUR! Down the track and gets the result! Kieran Powell breaks the shackles! Chisoro tosses it up outside off, Powell dances down the track and thrashes it wide of mid off for a boundary. It was a bit uppish but in the gap too.
Touch short outside off, punched off the back foot towards cover for a brisk single.
Slower again around middle, Kieran comes forward to defend but the ball turns away and it goes off the outer half of the bat towards point.
Short and turning away from a length, punched nicely off the back foot but fails to pierce the gap through cover.
Slower ball, landed full around off, kept out gently.
Too full around off, blocked off the front foot and into the ground.
Tossed up delivery outside off, pushed off the front foot towards cover.
Cremer and Raza are having a conversation. They are trying to get the fielders in their exact positions.

Another superb delivery! Tendai Chisoro loops it up outside off, Kraigg once again lunges forward to defend. Is done in by the flight as the ball turns away a touch to beat the outside edge. In the process he nearly loses his balance but recovers in time before the keeper takes the bails off. Well bowled, Tendai!
Slower through the air outside off, pushed with an angled bat towards backward point.
Gets behind the line this time and pokes it towards cover.

That's more like it! Chisoro needs to pitch more of those there! A loopy delivery outside off, lures Brathwaite to defend it and the batsman obliges. The ball turns away with a little bit of bounce to beat the outside edge of his bat.
Flighted ball around middle and off, flicked through mid-wicket for a single.
Tossed up delivery on off, Powell dances down the track and blocks it back down the pitch.
On middle and leg, wristed towards mid-wicket.
A bit fuller outside off, driven back to the bowler.
Comes a touch forward and plays it with the spin towards square leg.
Fired full on the pads, defended in front of the short leg fielder.
Quicker through the air around middle, worked on the bounce towards the man at short leg.
Raza lands it around middle, turning in, Kraigg works it with the spin towards square leg.
Stays back footed and tucks it behind square on the leg side.
Nice flight, landed full on off, pushed back to the bowler off the front foot.
A bit quicker through the air around middle and off, defended off the back foot.
Tosses it up around off, bunted back to the bowler.
Loopy full toss outside off, should have been put away but Powell finds the fielder at short cover.
Flighted delivery miles outside off, Powell gets his front foot across and pads it away towards the first slip fielder.
Tossed up on middle, dealt with expertly.
Leans into this one and eases it to long on for a single.
The batsman defends it from within the crease.
Tossed up on off, stays low. Powell camps back to block it.

Nervy moment for Brathwaite! Pushed quicker through the air on off, Brathwaite hangs back to block it but gets it off the outer half towards point for a single. He departed in the first Test to the same bowler as he was adjudged LBW. This time a little bit of bat saves him.
Fullish on off, pushed off the front foot to mid on.
Goes back and defends it towards the mid-wicket fielder.
Flighted ball outside off, pushed into the cover region.
On middle and leg, nudged towards the leg side.
Darted on middle, flicked through mid-wicket for a single.

In the air... just falls short of Mire at long on! Chisoro gives it a nice flight, Powell clears his front leg and thumps it down the ground towards long on. It went flat and Mire stationed there moves quickly across to his left, dives forward to take it but the ball falls short. Tendai lauds the fielding effort from the Zimbabwe opener. A single picked up.
Starts off from over the wicket and keeps it full around middle, defended nicely off the back foot.
Tendai Chisoro is brought into the attack now. Let's see what the debutant can extract from the surface. To start with, he was a medium pace bowler but now he is a left-arm orthodox.
Flatter one around middle, tucked off the back foot towards forward short leg.
Floats it up on the stumps, Kraigg dead bats it.
Goes deep in the crease and tucks it towards square leg.
Leans forward and drives it towards short cover.
The commentator on-air informs that 28 overs have been bowled in 1 and a half hours. Brilliant over rate from Zimbabwe. Seems like they are going to easily make up for the overs lost yesterday.
Floats it up around middle, defended by lunging forward.

Darts it around the leg stump, Powell wrists it through mid-wicket for a single. The 50-run stand for the opening wicket comes up for the Windies. These two have done a really good job. Can they build on this now?
It's the googly from the skipper again, Brathwaite fails to pick it up. Manages to tuck it past short leg somehow.
Dances down the track and drives it through covers for a single.
Short and turning in, tucked with the spin towards backward square leg.
Loopy full toss, dipping in, flicked to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Too full in length, Brathwaite looks to drive it through the line but gets it off the inner half towards mid on.
Drops it short on middle, pulled off the back foot through mid-wicket for a couple of runs.
Fuller outside off, pushed towards short cover. Raza has ran through his over, he has completed it in just over a minute.
Hangs back and keeps it out of the crease.
Flattish through the air around middle, defended off the back foot.
Around middle and off, blocked off the front foot.

Is it another dropped chance? Nope, it's not! Raza lands it around middle and it zips off the surface to beat the outside edge of the bat. It seemed like an edge but the replays confirm there wasn't any.
Flatter one outside off, Powell has got nothing to do with that.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Fuller on middle, driven off the inner half towards mid on.
Gets right behind the line and blocks it out watchfully.
Drags his length back a bit, Brathwaite pulls it through mid-wicket for a couple of runs.
Flighted delivery around off, defended by coming forward.
Googly around off, Kraigg reads it well and defends it off the back foot.

What a delivery! Ripper is what sounds apt for it! Raza lands it around middle, it's not that short but Powell goes back to defend. This one turns away with a little bit of bounce, beats the outside edge and was millimeters away from kissing the off stump.

Good shot and good stop too! Raza gives it some nice air, keeps it full outside off. Brathwaite presses forward and laces it through wide mid off. Tendai Chisoro from mid off sprints after it and does extremely well to save a run for his side.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Flatter one on middle, punched off the back foot towards mid-wicket.
Lets the ball turn in and with the spin works it behind square on the leg side.
Tossed up outside off, driven hard but finds the cover fielder.
Short and outside off, Powell rocks back and flays it through covers. Peter Moor gives it a chase and pulls the ball back in play near the rope. Two taken.
A bit short on middle, defended off the back foot.
Reads the wrong 'un from the hand does Powell and quickly goes deep in the crease to negotiate.
Tossed up around off, Powell lunges forward to defend but the ball turns in, takes the inside edge and rolls past the man at short leg.
Stays on the back foot and meets it with a straight bat.

FOUR! Glorious! That was a flashy drive from Powell! Cremer tosses it up wider outside off, it's a gentle half-volley. Powell gets across and drills it past the diving extra cover fielder to pick up a boundary.
Leans ahead and buries it into the ground. A maiden for Raza.
Tossed up around off, turning in, Brathwaite goes back and flicks it towards backward square leg.
Defended off the back foot by the batsman.
Goes back and tucks it past short leg.
This one spins back in from around off, flicked towards mid-wicket.
Fired very full, almost a yorker, jammed out back to the bowler.
Bowls a googly around middle, Powell goes back and shows a straight blade.
There comes a loose ball! The leg-spinners are ought to deliver one. A loopy full toss, dipping in, flicked off the inner half through mid-wicket by Brathwaite for one.
Kieran comes down the track this time and drives it wide of mid off to get a single.
Fuller around off, bunted towards the fielder at mid off.
Loops it up around middle, nudged straight to short mid-wicket.
A bit flatter through the air outside off, punched off the back foot towards cover.
Goes over the wicket, drops it around middle, Kraigg goes back and works it with the spin towards square leg.
Loopy delivery around middle and leg, worked through mid-wicket for a single.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Darts it around the pads, worked in front of mid-wicket.
Raza smartly slows it through the air, bowls it around middle, it turns away. Powell looks to flick but gets a leading edge which falls short of the bowler. Powell is living dangerously here.
Around middle, turning away, stabbed off the back foot.
Short and turning away from a length, KB hangs back and defends.
Takes a stride forward and pushes it towards mid off.
Keeps it full on off, watchfully kept out.
Loops it up around off, defended into the ground.
On a shorter length and spinning further away, Brathwaite leans across and makes a leave at the last moment.
Flighted around off, blocked off the front foot gently.
Slower one outside off, dabbed away towards point.
Drops it short, spinning away, punched towards cover.
Flighted ball outside off, Kieran leans forward and lets it be.
Kieran shoulders arms to let that one through.
Loopy ball around middle and off, defended off the front foot.
Raza pushes it quicker through the air, outside off, Powell gets on the front foot and then makes a leave.
Flatter ball on middle, punched back to the bowler.
Quicker through the air outside off, left alone.
FOUR! That's a poor delivery and had HIT ME written all over it. Short ball, Kraigg camps back and pulls it through mid-wicket for a boundary.

Another chance! But this one was relatively tough! Floats it up on the stumps, Powell skips down the track and drills it back down the ground. Cremer moves to his left and then tries to catch it but it bursts through his fingers down to long on for a single. Two chances created in the same over but they haven't been grabbed!
Flighted delivery around middle, clipped towards mid-wicket.

Was that a return catch? Oh, yes it was! Graeme Cremer has spilled a dolly of a catch. Butter fingers, I tell you! Floated delivery around middle, Powell comes dancing down the track and chips it back to the bowler who fails to grab that one. Initially it seemed like a bump ball but replays show it wasn't. A chance goes down abegging.
Graeme Cremer to bowl from the other end.
In the air... but safe! Turning into Brathwaite who clips it uppishly past the short leg fielder. The ball is certainly spinning a lot.
Gets right forward to this one and blocks it right under his nose.
Spinning in sharply into Brathwaite who looks to keep it out but is struck on the pads. The ball lobs to the short leg fielder.
On the pads again, nudged to the man at short fine leg.
Drifting towards the pads, played with soft hands to mid-wicket for a single.
Tossed up outside off, spinning away. Powell lets it go.

We are back for the third session. Brathwaite and Powell to continue their innings. Will their approach be the same? Digging out everything and keeping the hosts at bay? Let's wait and find out... Sikandar Raza to continue his spell. A slip and short leg in place. Here we go...
... Day 2, Session 3 ...

A session that belongs to West Indies! Not that they have run away with the game but they have done really well so far. Firstly, they wiped the hosts' tail quickly and then their openers, Brathwaite and Powell, have safely negotiated the tricky period before the break. The Zimbabwe bowlers bowled superbly, especially Mpofu, who ran in with all his might but didn't get any success. Skipper Cremer and Raza too got the ball to turn and grip which must have put some questions in the mind of the batsmen. Expect more of that once the play resumes. Will we see the visitors dominate proceedings or will the hosts deny them by picking wickets? Join us back in a short while...
Slow through the air, Brathwaite is opened up in his stance a bit but does well to keep it out. THAT'S TEA ON DAY 2!
Spinning down the leg side, worked to fine leg for a single.
Sits deep in the crease and blocks it watchfully.
Slips in the googly this time, Powell reads it well and defends it solidly.
Flatter one, blocked off the back foot.
Full delivery, driven crisply to mid off.
Tossed up delivery, defended solidly off the front foot.
Streaky! Full outside off, Brathwaite pushes at it with hard hands but gets it off the outer half to short third man.
Eased to covers off the front foot this time.
Spinning in from outside off, Brathwaite smothers it nicely.
Spinning towards the pads, helped to the leg side.
Flat and quick, kept out watchfully.

Ian Bishop is not happy with the field placement by Cremer. Like Holder, he too has spread the field. Why would you want to allow those easy singles down the ground? Imply more pressure, frustrate the batsmen and make them desperate to go for a false stroke...
Quicker one outside off, Kraigg pushes it to long off for a run. Easy singles on offer, not good cricket from Zimbabwe.
Tossed up delivery, Brathwaite lunges forward in defense.
Full delivery on middle, played with soft hands down back to the bowler.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Quicker through the air, tapped with the spin to point.
Powell uses his feet to this one and wrists it to the short mid-wicket fielder.
Brathwaite seems to be struggling a bit. He calls the physio out who is helping him in some stretching...
Floated outside off, driven against the spin to covers. Good start from Raza.
Tossed up outside off, defended solidly off the back foot.
Fullish delivery, eased to mid on.
Plays this one with the spin to mid-wicket.
Tossed up delivery, kept out watchfully.

Action straightaway! A loud shout for an LBW turned down. A good first delivery. Outside off, turning in sharply. Brathwaite looks to defend it but misses to get rapped on the pads. Raza is confident but the umpire stays put. Cremer looks towards his keeper and he says that the impact is outside the line. Replays also confirm the same. Kraigg got out to Raza in the first Test and the bowler is already posing some problems for the right-hander.
Sikandar Raza comes into the attack. Can he pick up a wicket before tea?
Lack of game awareness from the hosts. Tossed up on off, Kraigg drives it firmly towards mid off. The fielder is late to react and allows the single.
A fraction short this time, Brathwaite rocks back and cuts it through covers. Raza hares after it and does well to keep it down to a couple.
Leans forward to this one and blocks it.
Quick and flat around off, spinning away. The right-hander shuffles a bit and defends it nicely.
Full on off, Brathwaite lunges forward in defense.
Quicker through the air around off, Kraigg stays back and defends it towards point.
Fractionally overpitched outside off, Powell leans into it and drives it crisply to extra cover. Finally a run in this over.
Fullish in length outside off, pushed off the front foot to covers.
On a length on off, stays a bit low. Powell hangs back and adjusts well to block it.
Good length delivery outside off, Kieran plants his front foot across to let it go.
Mpofu comes back to around the wicket angle to the southpaw and bowls it on a length outside off. Tapped nicely to the point region.
A lot of swing there. Fullish delivery outside off, jagging back sharply. Brathwaite clips it off the inner half to deep backward square leg. A run taken.
Fraction short, pulled to wide long on for a run.

Already something happening from the skipper. Tossed up on a shortish length outside off, gets it to spin in appreciably. Powell hangs back and looks to defend it but gets an outside edge past first slip. Three runs taken. Kieran should have played that off the front foot.
Slow through the air this time, defended solidly off the front foot.
Stays back to the flatter delivery and blocks it.
In line of the stumps, turned through mid-wicket for a run.
Tossed up on off, Brathwaite lunges forward to defend it.
Time for Graeme Cremer to roll his arm over. We saw Bishoo extracting good purchase from the surface and the skipper will look to give his best.
In the zone outside off, left alone. Fourth maiden in a row. Looks like the Windies are playing out for tea.
Well bowled! Coming in with the angle from around off and straightens after pitching. Powell does well to not follow it.
Length delivery outside off, holding its line. Powell doesn't flirt with it.
Defended off the back foot by the batsman.
In the channel outside off, Kieran doesn't fiddle with it.
Mpofu steams in and bowls a back of a length delivery on off, Powell hangs back and taps it to the point fielder.
Shuffles across to the length delivery and buries it into the track.
Same length but wider outside off, the right-hander is not bothered to play at that one.
On a driving length outside off, the temptation is there to go for the drive but Kraigg remains circumspect in approach.
Another full delivery in line of the stumps, Kraigg comes forward to defend it but gets it off the outer half to covers.
Full delivery on middle, Kraigg leans ahead and plays it with soft hands to mid on.
Good length delivery in the corridor of uncertainty, Brathwaite moves across his stumps and defends it solidly.
Fullish delivery but wide outside off, Powell lets it go. Back-to-back maidens.
Good carry and bounce! Length delivery outside off, lifts appreciably after pitching as Kieran points his bat skywards.
Full delivery outside off, Powell doesn't flirt with it.
On a driving length well outside off, Powell resists the urge to drive it and lets it go through safely.
On a length on off, tucked off the inner half of the bat to mid-wicket.
Back of a length delivery, angling in from outside off. Powell shuffles a touch and stonewalls it.
Full in length on off, driven crisply to the man at mid on. End of a maiden.
Full length delivery on middle, a bit of away swing there. Brathwaite closes his bat face early on the clip and hence, gets a soft leading edge towards the second slip fielder.
Mire opts to go full again and attacks the base of the off stump. Brathwaite comes forward and defends it with a high elbow.
Rises with the bounce to the short of the length delivery and taps it to the off side.
Good length delivery in the zone outside off, Kraigg shuffles a bit and punches it firmly to the cover region.
Full delivery on off, Kraigg puts his head down and defends it calmly.

FOUR! Streaky runs! This is good bowling from Mpofu. He bowls a full length ball outside off, Powell pushes at it with minimal foot movement and gets an outside edge through the gap between the slip cordon and gully. Picks up his first boundary.
Short of a length outside off, Powell plays it with an angled bat face towards point.
A bit fuller outside off, Powell makes the third leave in a row.
Good length delivery outside off, zips off the surface. Kieran keeps his bat inside the line and lets it go.
Hurls one in the channel outside off at 139 clicks, much more than his usual pace. Powell makes a watchful leave. Mpofu is really running in and giving it his all. The crowd is also cheering for him.
Back of a length delivery outside off, tapped with an open bat face to point.
Fuller in length outside off, Kraigg pushes it off the front foot to covers.
Length delivery around off, Brathwaite waits for it and blocks it.
Fazeer Mohammed on-air mentions a good point. He mentions that it is important to have quality bowlers bowling upfront with the new ball. It gives the side a cushion and they can attack more.
Straying on the pads, turned around the corner for a single.
Full length delivery, Kieran lunges forward in defense.
Very full delivery on off, Powell jams it out back to the bowler. Mire is not looking his hundred percent and might be bowling with an injury.
Full delivery wide outside off, Powell is not bothered to play at it.
The hammer comes out. The groundsman is settling the area near the bowler's landing.
Short of a length outside off, holding its line. Kraigg doesn't bother to play at it.
Good length delivery just outside off, Brathwaite remains composed in defense.
Full length delivery around off, pushed off the bottom half of the bat to mid off.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Good length delivery around off, Kraigg hangs back and defends it stoutly.
FOUR! Poor delivery and duly punished! Short and room on offer, Brathwaite slaps it past the point region for a boundary.
Fullish delivery on leg stump, nudged round the corner for a single.
Fuller length ball outside off, keeps low. Kraigg lets it go. That died on the keeper. Signs of things to come?
Fractionally overpitched on off, eased off the front foot to mid off.
Fullish delivery around off, Brathwaite shuffles a touch and works it to square leg.
Brathwaite shuffles a bit and taps this one with a closed bat face to the leg side.
Fullish delivery in line of the stumps, Brathwaite flicks it to mid-wicket.
Solomon Mire to share the new ball from the other end. He has been handed the responsibility as Kyle Jarvis is not playing in this game.
On a length, extra bounce on that. Brathwaite keeps it out off the inner half of the bat to fine leg. A run taken.
Fullish delivery, swinging in sharply. Brathwaite brings his bat down at an angle and clips it to mid-wicket.
Full length delivery on off, defended solidly off the front foot.
Mpofu loses his radar and slips this one down the leg side, Kraigg tries to help it away but misses. Chakabva dives to his left but fails to stop it cleanly. Two byes taken.
Good length ball angling in from outside off, Brathwaite hangs back and answers it with a straight bat.
Starts off with a full length ball outside off, Brathwaite plants his front foot across and lets it go.
